data.title: Watch: Six Months on the Pamir Highway
The Fortresses of Ishkashim
data.text: Perched on river bluffs, the mud-brick fortresses of the Wakhan speak in a language older than the nations that now claim this land.
data.text2: I spent two days photographing them at dawn.
